policy.prior_decisions: EDIT0011 supersedes only the spelling-layer subdecisions that introduced or preserved visible ć/đ on a claimed basic surface. It retains their semantic and lexical decisions and preserves all adverse history.
policy.rule: Every visible ISV ć becomes č and every visible ISV đ becomes dž. The two transformations are exact official standard-orthography rules, not corpus-frequency guesses.
policy.scope_boundary: Only reader-visible ISV word tokens are eligible. TeX commands, comments, math syntax, foreign spans, identifiers, and protected source payloads are excluded by the pinned v2 segmenter; this cohort contains zero optional-consonant token in a non-visible role.
